system.description:
[Trigger: Action] Use this when you perform a [Magic Attack]. If the [Magic Attack] inflicts [Dazed][Rigor][Staggered], it also inflicts [Afflicted]. You take [Pursuit:20]. A ring with an intricate design of a deep coloration where blood and darkness have melted together. The magic power overflowing from this ring greatly enhances the effects of mental-interference type magic.

Jet-Black Shard [Core Material] (180G) + Yellow Ring (360G) + Convulsion Poison (Intermediate) (140G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 10] (110G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (420G)
